caption: The video showcases a top-down play surface bordered by a yellow paint smear at the upper-left and blue paint smears at the right and lower-right. A light wooden board carved with a serpentine groove lies diagonally across the center, joined at its lower end to a blue plastic track fitted with orange rollers. At the upper-right, a hand grips a dark brown cylinder against the top of the groove, making slight adjustments while the layout stays still. The view then changes abruptly, with the hand gone and a blue-purple cylinder now resting at the top of the groove, while the dark brown cylinder lies on the table to the left of the board among the scattered colored cups. This arrangement holds still for a stretch. The board and track themselves do not move. Then a purple ball appears at the lower-left end of the roller track and translates steadily up and to the right along the orange rollers toward the wooden board, continuing its climb as the clip ends.
